bull_case: AI monetization plus continued share-count shrinkage can support Bull value above $800.
bear_case: If AI commoditizes creative workflows and growth fades, Bear value around $234 leaves little downside cushion from current price.
thesis: At $248.92, Adobe trades at about half the locked Base DCF of ~$495.57. The valuation no longer requires heroic execution; the market is pricing substantial AI disruption or structurally lower growth. Base still assumes owner FCF/share grows from about $20 to $38 over ten years, which is demanding but consistent with high margins, buybacks and low-teens subscription growth.

evidence.claim: H1 OCF was $5.123B, PP&E purchases $95M, and SBC $1.043B.
Q3 revenue was $6.76B, ARR $27.50B and OCF $2.52B.
ADBE TTM P/E is at the 6th percentile of trailing 5-year weekly observations as of 2026-09-18; cash-flow and EV-based multiples independently sit near the 5th-6th percentile.

counterevidence: AI lowers content-creation barriers and could shift value from application vendors toward models, distribution layers or new agentic workflows.
unknowns: Long-run AI monetization per user, Firefly inference economics, and how much AI-first ARR is incremental versus bundled/reclassified ARR.
falsifiers: If ARR growth falls to low single digits while AI usage rises, or owner FCF/share stops compounding despite buybacks, the moat/compounder thesis is downgraded.

hard_veto_flags.rationale: Current price is below Base and far below Bull, so it does not require an unrealistic Bull+ case.
